products.description:
Get SharePoint permissions under control — no more broken inheritance

SharePoint permissions rot into a tangle of broken inheritance, unique permissions, and over-shared sites nobody can audit. This solution establishes a permissions and access model: group-based access (SharePoint groups + Entra/M365 groups), a standard permission-level model, controlling unique permissions and broken inheritance, site-access reviews, and access reporting — so who-can-see-what is intentional and auditable.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the permission model: SharePoint groups vs Entra/M365 groups, permission levels, inheritance vs unique permissions, access reviews, and reporting.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites with how to verify/implement (SPO admin, group source of truth, IA/site structure, governance stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — define the group-based model + permission levels, remediate broken inheritance/unique permissions, wire site-access reviews, and stand up access reporting — pilot-first, each group/level named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic SharePoint Online Management Shell / PnP PowerShell / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (access group-based, inheritance intact where intended, over-share reduced) plus Best Practices for durable permission hygiene.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

SharePoint access made intentional and auditable — group-based, standard permission levels, broken inheritance remediated, reviews running — the permission tangle untangled.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SPOPERM-AccessReview.ps1 — Reporting / access review (READ-ONLY): produces "Access Report - SPO - Report" -- a who-has-access
    • SPOPERM-Discovery.ps1 — Discovery (READ-ONLY): produces the "Permission Audit - SPO - Discovery" baseline for a site --
    • SPOPERM-Remediate-GroupAccess.ps1 — Remediation (SAFE BY DEFAULT / -WhatIf): moves a site to GROUP-BASED access -- ensures the standard
    • SPOPERM-Reset-Inheritance.ps1 — Remediation (SAFE BY DEFAULT / -WhatIf): resets scopes with BROKEN INHERITANCE back to inherit --
    • SPOPERM-Scope.ps1 — Scope / health helper (READ-ONLY): pre-flight check that the toolchain, sign-in, roles, and site scope

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
